subject: Roadshow crew rebook request — flight block shuffle + hotel night add
body:
From: Samir Patel <samir@baysideconf.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: URGENT: Redwood booth crew - two flights cancelled

Marissa —

Quick heads up: United just informed us that two of your outbound flights (AA 437 & UA 1209) were cancelled due to crew shortages. That leaves your booth with only 3 people instead of 7 for the 9/12 roadshow. We have standby local crew but they need badges and hotel nights — can Redwood confirm whether you can rebook replacements or if you want us to contract local temp staff?

I attached the venue-floorplan.pdf so you can see the badge pickup staging. We also have a hotel hold that can add rooms for one extra night if you confirm by EOD.

— Samir
Bayside Conference Operations

Attachment: venue-floorplan.pdf (pdf)

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir@baysideconf.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Redwood booth crew - two flights cancelled

Thanks Samir — appreciate the flag.

Vanessa / Logan, can you both confirm backup availability? We have two reserve flights on Delta (earlier) but if those can't be made we'll need to: 1) reassign some SD-based engineers to the booth for the first half day, and 2) book local temps for badge/hamper duties.

I'm looping in our travel rep (Michael O'Neil) to push on rebooking options; Michael if you can send available flight pairs for 9/11 evening & 9/12 morning that would be great. I attached a quick itinerary draft (rdw-itinerary-draft.xlsx) showing who covers which shift — it's provisional.

We need a firm decision by 18:00 PT today so Samir can extend the hotel hold.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment: rdw-itinerary-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet)

-----

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Redwood booth crew - two flights cancelled

Marissa — I can flex. Logan confirmed he can shift his return to stay through the afternoon and cover the midday shift.

Backup plan A (preferred): Rebook two inbound flights tonight (9/11) arriving before 11am 9/12 — that gives us full coverage.
Backup plan B: If rebook isn't possible, we request two local temps Samir recommended; Redwood to cover one hotel night each.

Putting it plainly: please try to secure rebooks first. If not, approve local hires and hotel add.

— Vanessa
Senior Events Coordinator | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com

-----

From: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@deltaenterprise.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@baysideconf.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Delta rebook options (block inventory)

Hi Marissa / team —

We pulled a couple of workable options from the block. See attached delta-block-options.pdf which includes two itineraries: Option 1 (9/11 PM red-eye -> 9/12 07:20 arrival) and Option 2 (9/12 06:15 redeploy via connection, earlier fare). Pricing in the sheet reflects same-day change fees waived for the block.

If you confirm passenger names and PNRs, we can lock within 2 hours. Note: Option 1 uses a smaller aircraft into the regional airport; luggage allowance is restricted (carry-on only) unless you pay the supplemental.

— Michael O'Neil
Strategic Accounts — Delta Enterprise Sales
m.oneil@deltaenterprise.com | +1 (303) 555-0124

Attachment: delta-block-options.pdf (pdf)

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@baysideconf.com>, reservations@harborsuites.com
Cc: Michael O'Neil <m.oneil@deltaenterprise.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2027 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: CONFIRMED: rebook Option 1 for two inbound staff; hotel stay added

Samir / Harborsuites reservations —

We will take Delta Option 1 for the two rebooked staff (names below). Please add one additional hotel night for both (check-in 9/11, check-out 9/13) — charge Redwood corporate card on file.

Passengers to rebook:
- Priya Natarajan (will travel from SFO)
- Karthik Iyer (will travel from SFO)

Vanessa: Priya and Karthik, please confirm any baggage needs now so Michael can add the supplement if required.

Samir: please release the two temp badge holds if we are good on rebooks; otherwise we may need temp support for two shifts starting 10:00 on 9/12 for setup.

Thanks,
Marissa

-----

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CONFIRMED: rebook Option 1 for two inbound staff; hotel stay added

On Fri, Sep 10, 2027 at 02:30 PM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Samir / Harborsuites reservations —
>
> We will take Delta Option 1 for the two rebooked staff (names below). Please add one additional hotel night for both (check-in 9/11, check-out 9/13) — charge Redwood corporate card on file.

All noted. Travel team confirms both PNRs have been updated and Delta has waived the change fees. I also bumped the exhibitor badge list to include the temps as backups (Samir — see new badge IDs via your portal).

We should be good but please keep an eye on arrivals and ping the front desk if baggage is needing tagging. I'll be on site morning of 9/12 to handle escalation.

— Vivek
VP, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0187
